descriptions.text: FortuneWheel was suspected to have been attacked on BSC, resulting in an approximate loss of $21.6K.

FortuneWheel, a BNB Chain GameFi contract, was exploited on January 10, 2025 after an attacker manipulated PancakeSwap pricing around the protocol’s public swapProfitFees() routine. Available transaction evidence and public analyses indicate the attacker exited with about 30.968 WBNB, valued near $21,000 to $22,000 at the time. Public analyses and transaction traces indicate that FortuneWheel’s swapProfitFees() routine executed AMM swaps using manipulable spot pricing without effective slippage protection.
